create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs
set_and_get_graph_weights: set graph arc weights via list or numpy array and retrieve them
add_subtract_negate_graphs_with_backward: add subtract or negate two scalar graphs and compute gradients with backward
compare_and_save_load_graphs: compare two graphs for equality or isomorphism and save or load them to disk
run_parallel_graph_operations: run parallel graph operations like add concat or remove across a batch of graphs
